Description
The Vicat Dry instrument features a quick and easy operation suitable for research and development, production monitoring, and education and training procedures. It utilizes an oil-free measuring method that guarantees a clean and odor-free operating processes while the test orders remain automatic. It also works with automatic positioning of test weight and performs a re-cooling mechanism using water or compressed air. Furthermore, the instrument is also available in different versions with 2 or 6 testing areas.
